content.text: Upscale boutique hotel near Prague Market

Located close to National Memorial at Vitkov and Army Museum Zizkov, Hotel PULSE8 provides a library, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a fireplace in the lobby. The on-site international cuisine restaurant, Pentalounge, offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, light fare, and kids' meals. Free in-room WiFi is available to all guests, along with a bar and a gym.
Additional perks include:

• Limo/town car service, buffet breakfast (surcharge), and self parking (surcharge)
  • An electric car charging station, express check-out, and a foosball table
  • Secured bicycle storage, a music library, and local meal delivery service
  • Guest reviews say great things about the helpful staff
Room features
All 227 rooms boast comforts such as laptop-friendly workspaces and air conditioning, in addition to thoughtful touches like free WiFi and safes.
More conveniences in all rooms include:

• LED light bulbs and eco-friendly cleaning products
  • Bathrooms with heated floors and rainfall showers
  • 42-inch flat-screen TVs with premium channels
  • Wardrobes/closets, highchairs, and elliptical machines
